overview_description.description:
Rootline is payments infrastructure built for platforms.
Marketplaces, SaaS businesses, and software platforms are increasingly expected to move money, not just process a checkout. Most are forced to bolt that onto systems designed for single merchants: rigid account structures, manual reconciliation, and almost no visibility into where funds actually sit.
We built Rootline to remove those workarounds. Our building blocks let you onboard and verify your customers, accept payments across cards, wallets, and local methods, programmatically route funds across a network of accounts, and control exactly when payouts are released, scheduled or on demand. Every transaction lands on a live ledger in real time, so reconciliation is automatic and your fees, balances, and payouts stay visible down to the cent.
The result is lower operational cost, full ownership of your payment experience, and more revenue captured per transaction through flexible pricing and dynamic markups. Fintech becomes a core part of your business, not an add-on.
Rootline was founded by people who built and scaled financial infrastructure at leading fintechs before starting from a blank page in Amsterdam. We embrace AI, but our support is always human, we pick up the phone.
